lines.t: He stepped back, ‘cause we stepped back, now we strugglin’ just to hear Him �
Kingdom in my chest, poor in spirit, know I need Him �
When He step back, that’s pressure, that’s love in disguise �
Make me hunger for His voice, put the thirst in my eyes �
Blessed are the poor in spirit, they gon’ walk through that door �
Kingdom sittin’ in my chest, but I still ask Him for more �
He said, “I moved backward, ‘cause YOU moved backward, you drifted” �
Closed up the table, now your trust gotta be lifted �
Fed you meat from My hand, poured My heart in your ear �
Now I’m silent for a season, just to test if you fear �
I was leanin’ on a prophet, treatin’ man like the Rock �
He removed the lampstand, pulled the shepherd off the block �
Left alone with the mirror, had to look in my soul �
Had to face all the secrets, let confession take hold �
Thought I knew Him as He is, had Him fit in my frame �
But His ways above the heavens, I was playin’ with His name �
Church talk, big talk, but my spirit was poor
Till He stripped all my support, laid me flat on the floor �
When He step back, that’s pressure, that’s love in disguise �
Make me hunger for His voice, put the thirst in my eyes �
Blessed are they that hunger, thirst for righteousness’ rain �
He gon’ fill ‘em with His life, make ‘em rise from the pain �
Kingdom ain’t in these lights, it ain’t stuck in these pews �
It’s a fire in the temple where His Spirit moves �
When He quiet all the noise, you can hear that within
Still voice cut deep, call you outta your sin �
He said, “Crucify yourself daily, lay it all on the line
Who you choose gon’ define how you walk, how you grind.” �
So I die to my image, let His Word be the blade �
Let Him tear down every idol that my own hands made �
Poor in spirit, I’m empty, that’s the place He will fill �
When I’m broken and I’m honest, He revealin’ His will �
Now I’m searchin’ for His Kingdom, not the fame, not the clout
Just that wellspring of YahuShua that can never run out �
When He step back, that’s pressure, that’s love in disguise �
Make me hunger for His voice, put the thirst in my eyes �
Seek first His Kingdom in you, seek His righteousness first �
He gon’ meet you in that desert, quench the deepest of thirst �
So if He step back from your life, don’t run to the crowd �
Fall into Him unreserved, cry His name out loud �
‘Cause the ones that know they need Him, He gon’ raise ‘em up high
And the proud that think they know Him, they gon’ break when He’s dry �
